string.text: %c[255,96,160,255]Item Popups Offset%c[default]: Adds an X offset slider to Popup Messages so item pickup toasts can be moved left or right. Set under Popup Messages.
Shifts pickup toasts left (negative) or right (positive) after APM's slide-in. Stock Position X is overwritten by the animation; this offset is applied after that. Default 0.
